Title: Employee can apply for leave
Steps:
1. Log in as Employee
2. Submit leave request

Title: Manager approves own team's leave
Steps:
1. Log in as Manager
2. Approve direct report's request

Title: HR Admin views all employees' leave
Steps: 1. Open leave list as HR Admin

Title: Employee cannot approve/reject leave
Steps:
1. Log in as Employee
2. Look for Team Requests menu
3. Open approvals URL directly
Expected Result: Menu hidden; direct URL shows 403/access denied

Title: Employee cannot edit leave balances
Steps: 1. Open balance admin URL as Employee

Title: Manager cannot approve non-direct report
Steps:
1. Open other team's request URL
2. Attempt approve via UI and API

Title: Manager views team-only leave list
Steps:
1. Open leave list as Manager
2. Filter/search for non-team employee
Expected Result: Only direct reports shown; non-team employee not found

Title: Manager cannot approve own leave
Steps:
1. Manager applies for leave
2. Attempt to approve it
Expected Result: Not allowed; routed to their manager/HR

Title: Role downgrade takes effect in active session
Steps:
1. Manager logged in
2. HR changes role to Employee
3. Manager tries to approve
